Hc.bar_b_note: B's lava-seamed plates give the boar a strong identity, but on both sides the faint-mid body hangs above its shadow, and A's faint-end goes crushed black, so the finish stays below Palworld's creature bar.

Rn.bar_b_note: The grandpa's clean stylised sculpt, groomed hair and beard, and earthy green-brown costume reach a shipping-game character finish; flat button eyes with no highlight are the main weakness.

Bs.bar_b_note: A dim, flat-lit face with tiny dark eyes and an all-black outfit sits on a near-black stage, so the silhouette and faction identity (no oxblood mark) disappear.

Dh.bar_b_note: Smeared, stretched ground textures, empty flat fields, a giant flat-textured stronghold wall and flat midday light without atmosphere sink it, even though B's aftermaths tell a story.

Uu.bar_b_note: Same finish as Rn: an appealing, well-groomed stylised villager whose palette fits the key-art village, held back only by lifeless solid-black eyes.

Sb.bar_b_note: B's capped, braced, stone-footed timber frame now reads as built, but the untextured beige infill, the lone freestanding segment and the pale faceted placeholder boulder beside it keep it short of Palworld base-building finish.

top_changes.change: World ground and light pass for the Meadows play space: replace smeared, stretched ground textures, break the flat fields into groves, edges and clearings, and add a warm time-of-day grade with blue distance fog (Dh, Sb)

Make every enemy-site aftermath specific to its site and drop the repeated emblem boulder: banners torn down, cages opened with freed captives, tents burned to smoke, crates broken (B already points this way; A leaves the banners up)

New material and shading pass for Team Tether characters and props: lit faces with eye highlights, an oxblood faction mark on the outfit, and a textured replacement for the pale faceted placeholder boulder
